title: Root cause of #6197: #5831 (in 5.2.3) made Package.collect() eagerly import the package __init__.py via _mount_obj_if_needed(), so any non-test __init__.py (e.g. windows-only) is imported during collection and errors abort the run
evidence_refs: git show 19a15a94e (merge of PR #6197, parent = current HEAD e856638ba)
changelog fragment: 'Fix incorrect discovery of non-test __init__.py files.'

title: Bug #6197 reproduced on the checkout: a non-test foobar/__init__.py containing 'assert False' is collected and its import error interrupts the whole run (1 error during collection)
evidence_refs: run: pytest-5.2.3.dev0 (checkout src/) on C:/Windows/Temp/rep6197 with foobar/__init__.py='assert False' + test_foo.py -> 'ERROR collecting foobar/__init__.py ... AssertionError ... Interrupted: 1 errors during collection'

title: Fix verified: after the change, pytest 5.2.3.dev0 no longer imports non-test foobar/__init__.py ('assert False') — run passes with 1 passed, matching the 5.2.2 behavior in the TASK.md report
